records.text: An unnamed source told Candace Owens that Laura Loomer demanded a supportive post from Donald Trump, Susie Wiles opposed it, and Trump's team ultimately conceded
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep qZ8RWfyuewQ)

appearances.snippet: I am told specifically that she was ranting, ranting to people because this is when she was deep in the throes of her psychosis about how she wasn't invited to the White House Correspondents' Dinner ... she demanded a tweet of support from Trump. ... I am told specifically that Suzy Wiles was staunchly opposed to credit to Suzy Wiles ... and yet Trump's team overall conceded.

verification.notes: Owens publicly attributed this account to unnamed sources, and current coverage repeats her allegation, but no named participant, documentary record, or independent reporting verifies that Loomer demanded the post, Wiles opposed it, and the team conceded. The anonymous-source account cannot be independently tested.
